subject: SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ — on-demand vs streaming admin-activity evidence retrieval
messages:
From: Amanda Li <amanda.li@novamed.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: audit_ops@novamed.com
Date: Sat, 4 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question: admin-activity evidence delivery options (SOC2 / SIG / CAIQ)

Hi Priya,

We're starting our evidence collection for the upcoming SOC 2 audit and a few SIG/CAIQ responses. Security is looking for a clear description of what you log for admin actions and the ways Redwood can deliver that evidence. Two specific asks from our side: 

1) Can you provide a persistent on-demand snapshot (signed) of admin-activity (operator actions, session metadata, role changes, API key events) for a given date range?
2) Do you support a streaming/incremental export (webhook or push to our S3) so we can ingest events continuously into our GRC pipeline?

Also important: redaction options for PII, timezone normalization, a manifest/checksum, and whether you can deliver both raw+redacted versions for compliance review.

Can you outline options, typical SLAs for producing a snapshot, and any constraints (retention windows, sampling, data residency)? If helpful we can do a 30-minute call — Amanda + our audit lead.

Thanks,
Amanda
Amanda Li
Director, Compliance
NovaMed

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Question: admin-activity evidence delivery options (SOC2 / SIG / CAIQ)

Hi Amanda — thanks for the clear list. Short answer: we support both snapshot (on-demand) and streaming patterns; each has trade-offs and slightly different custody controls. High-level options below; happy to walk through in a short call.

Attachments: admin-export-options-v1.pdf (summary matrix)

1) On-demand signed snapshot (recommended for attested packages)
   - What: Self-contained tarball with NDJSON files for each ledger (operator_actions.ndjson, session_events.ndjson, config_changes.ndjson) plus a signed manifest (.sha256) and HMAC.
   - Retention: Snapshots can be requested for any retained window; by default we retain 180 days of raw admin events for hosted customers. Longer retention available via contract.
   - Redaction: We produce two variants on request — raw and redacted (PII removed/masked). Redaction rules are configurable per field-set.
   - Delivery: HTTPS presigned URL, SFTP, or direct S3 push to customer bucket (server-side KMS). Typical SLA for a 30-day snapshot: 24–48 hours for staging + transfer.

2) Incremental / streaming delivery (recommended for continuous ingestion)
   - What: Real-time push to a customer endpoint (webhook) or to an S3 (multipart), Kinesis/Firehose, or streamed via an authenticated TLS connection. Events emitted as NDJSON with sequence IDs and checkpoint tokens.
   - Retention/Replay: Streams expose a 7–90 day replay window depending on contract; we can also create periodic compacted snapshots for point-in-time evidence.
   - Access controls: Mutual TLS, token rotation, IP allowlist, and per-stream ACLs.

3) Sampling, timezone & provenance
   - Sampling: We can produce full fidelity or a deterministic sample (prefix-based) for very large volumes. Sampling parameters are part of the request manifest.
   - Timestamp normalization: All events include UTC and local tz fields; delivered manifests include time zone normalization notes.
   - Provenance: Signed manifest with exporter identity, export timestamp, record counts, and SHA256 checksums.

Next steps: if you want the attested snapshot we’ll prepare a short runbook and estimated delivery time for your exact date range. Karthik — can you add the schema and a sample s3 path for NovaMed? Stephanie — can you add expected SOC 2-friendly retention defaults to the runbook?

Best,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Li <amanda.li@novamed.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 4 Mar 2028 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question: admin-activity evidence delivery options (SOC2 / SIG / CAIQ)

Hi Amanda / team — adding technical details to Priya's summary. Attaching a small schema and a sample path.

Attachments: export-manifest.schema.json, s3-path-sample.txt

Format & schema
- Each ledger file is NDJSON (newline-delimited JSON). One event per line; events include event_id, recorded_at (ISO8601 UTC), local_ts, actor.email, actor.principal_type, action_type, resource_type, resource_id, metadata (map).
- Manifest fields: exporter_id, export_id, export_range_start, export_range_end, record_counts, checksums {file:sha256}, hmac_signature.

Example delivery patterns
- Snapshot: s3://redwood-evidence/novamed/attested/snapshots/20280304_20280201-20280228/snapshot.tar.gz (server-side KMS; we can push to your bucket with customer-managed KMS).
- Streaming: realtime->firehose->s3 with daily compacted snapshot retained for 90 days. We can also provide an event cursor (sequence token) for exact replay.

Retention & replay windows
- Hosted default: raw admin events 180 days; redacted variants 365 days.
- Streaming replay: standard 30 days; optional 90 day window for enterprises.
- On-demand attested snapshot: we keep the signed snapshot artifacts for 365 days unless you request longer archival.

Redaction & attestations
- Redaction engine supports field patterns and deterministic hashing. We can produce raw + redacted bundles side-by-side for auditors.
- Chain-of-custody: we provide a signed manifest and delivery log (who pulled/pushed the artifact with timestamps and IPs).

Operational notes and SLA
- Snapshot request turnaround: typically 24–72 hours depending on size (we provide an ETA after we see the date range).
- Emergency retention pull / expedited: 8–24 hours for an additional operational fee.

If you can confirm preferred delivery (s3 push vs presigned download) and the date range you need, I’ll generate a draft export manifest and ETA.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal, Serving Infrastructure | Redwood Inference

Thanks — this is very helpful.

We'd like:
- An attested snapshot for Feb 1—Feb 28, 2028 (raw + redacted).
- Delivery: push to our S3 bucket (we will provide a customer-managed KMS ARN).
- Please include a chain-of-custody statement and the signed manifest.

Also please confirm SLA: best-effort ETA and whether expedited delivery (within 12 hours) is available and any costs.

I'm available for a 30-minute call Monday to finalize the runbook and transfer details.

Best,
Amanda
